name: claude-provider-switcher
description: Switch the Claude Code extension between API providers/gateways (LiteLLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax, local models, native subscription) with a sidebar UI, menu, hotkeys, and a status bar indicator.

enumDescriptions: Follow VS Code's display language, falling back to English.
claudeProviderSwitcher.language.markdownDescription: Language for the extension's own UI — menus, notifications, the sidebar, the status bar and the custom-providers table. Switches live. **Note:** command titles in the Command Palette and these setting descriptions are localized by VS Code's own display language, not this setting.

enumDescriptions: Switch the provider, then remind you to restart the session (new chat / Reload Window).
Switch the provider and immediately reload the window so the next Claude Code session starts against the new provider.
claudeProviderSwitcher.switchAction.markdownDescription: What happens when you switch a provider via the sidebar click, hotkey, cycle or menu. `Switch provider` leaves the running session alone (it sees the old env until restarted). `Switch provider & reload window` restarts the window right away — any unsaved work must be saved first.

claudeProviderSwitcher.profiles.markdownDescription: Provider profiles (no limit; hotkeys cover the first 10). Managed via the **Claude Providers** sidebar, or edited here. Selecting a profile writes its `env` to `#claudeCode.environmentVariables#`. **Do not commit real API keys.**

id.description: Stable internal id; links the profile to its API key in SecretStorage. Managed automatically.

env.description: Environment variables written to claudeCode.environmentVariables. The API key (ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN) is NOT stored here — it lives in SecretStorage.

claudeProviderSwitcher.customProviders.markdownDescription:
Extra providers added to the **Add provider** menu, on top of the ones bundled with the extension. Use this to add a provider that isn't in the built-in list. Each row pre-fills a new profile's Base URL and (optionally) the model mapping; the API key is still entered per-profile and kept in SecretStorage.

For a table editor, run **Claude Provider: Manage custom providers…** (or the *Add provider* menu → *Manage custom providers…*) instead of editing the raw JSON here.

name.description: Display name shown in the Add provider menu (e.g. "My Gateway").

baseUrl.description: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL for the provider's Anthropic-compatible endpoint (e.g. https://api.example.com/anthropic). Leave empty for a native-subscription-style entry.

local.description: List this under "Local servers" instead of "Anthropic-compatible providers".

icon.description: Optional logo: a PNG file name under media/providers/, or a VS Code codicon id (e.g. "server"). Defaults to the server codicon.

opusModel.description: Optional default model for the Opus tier (ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL).

sonnetModel.description: Optional default model for the Sonnet tier (ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL).

haikuModel.description: Optional default model for the Haiku tier (ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL).

claudeProviderSwitcher.showStatusBarItem.description: Show the active-provider indicator in the status bar.

claudeProviderSwitcher.writeClaudeSettin.markdownDescription: Also mirror the active provider into the Claude Code **CLI** config at `~/.claude/settings.json` (under its `env` key), so a `claude` run in a plain terminal — not just the VS Code extension — uses the same provider. Only the keys this extension manages (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, the model/timeout vars) are touched; everything else in that file is left as-is. **Note:** this writes the active provider's API key into `~/.claude/settings.json` in plain text.

claudeProviderSwitcher.showRestartHint.markdownDescription: After switching, tint the status bar item and add a reminder that the Claude Code session must restart (new chat / Reload Window) for the change to take effect. Clears on window reload.

claudeProviderSwitcher.applyPinnedOnOpen.description: When a workspace has a pinned provider, automatically switch to it on open. Pin a provider via the sidebar (right-click → Pin to this workspace) or the command palette.

claudeProviderSwitcher.autoFallbackOnApp.markdownDescription: When switching providers, first probe the target and, if it's unreachable, automatically fall back to its configured fallback provider (set per profile via **Edit → Fallback provider**). Adds a short network check to every switch. When off, use the **Switch with fallback** command for on-demand failover.

enumDescriptions: Only check reachability when you run the Check provider health command (default).
Check all providers automatically on a timer (see healthCheckIntervalMinutes).
claudeProviderSwitcher.healthCheck.markdownDescription: How the 🟢/🔴 reachability indicator is refreshed. The check uses `GET /v1/models`, which runs **no inference and costs no tokens**, so `periodic` is safe to leave on.

claudeProviderSwitcher.healthCheckInterv.markdownDescription: How often (in minutes) to refresh provider health when `#claudeProviderSwitcher.healthCheck#` is `periodic`.
